purpose: Explain the single patient present in harmonized source D0 but absent from primary source D0 without writing any patient identifier.

rules.primary: Rank all qualifying source D0 episodes by COALESCE(diagnosis date, admission date, discharge date), select the first episode, then apply age >=18.
rules.harmonized: Require a recorded diagnosis date before patient-level ranking, rank by diagnosis date, select the first eligible episode, then apply age >=18.
rules.followup: For harmonized-only D0 patients, inspect the episode that would have been selected by the primary ranking before the adult-age filter and classify why that patient was absent from primary D0.

outputs: whether a primary pre-age selected episode existed
whether that primary pre-age episode was under age 18
whether its diagnosis date was missing
whether the harmonized episode was later and different
interpretation_guardrail: This is a post-result mechanism audit. It does not alter the frozen ETL, primary Stage C analysis, or harmonized sensitivity.
